drafted_from: tool:read-a-decisions-worked-steps's kit and tool:read-a-method's row shape; written with the Progress port (read-data/progress-facts.mjs); read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Show my Progress: what is waiting for my answer and what I am working toward", with the account's screen. It runs tool:read-progress and answers the facts the Progress screen draws.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the account's screen as the caller reads it and keeps nothing.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show my Progress: what is waiting for my answer and what I am working toward", and give it the account's screen.
2. The AI calls tool:read-progress with origin, screen and sections_after.
3. Read what it answers: the waiting decisions, the pursuit tree, the invitation and the allowance line.

worked_examples.title: Progress on a free plan
worked_examples.ask: Show my Progress: what is waiting for my answer and what I am working toward
worked_examples.given: The account's screen on the free plan: 3 free decisions a month, 1 used, and no space pursuits.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered the Progress facts: {"free": true, "kind": "progress", "keeps": "Nothing from this decision is kept on the free plan.
